svg.title: Three Verifier configurations for code review
svg.desc: Revision 18 approved contract; implementation proposed. Three alternative review configurations share engine-owned in-memory state, existing Bifrost WAL persistence/recovery and File storage. PostgreSQL coordinates queued work. Takeover excludes stale writes; unavailable accepted state causes wait/retry. Text alternative: diagram-notes.md.
svg.text: Three ways to build a review Verifier.
REVISION 18 CONTRACT · Engine state / Bifrost WAL · PostgreSQL queue · Existing publication contracts
ALTERNATIVE CONFIGURATIONS — choose one Verifier pattern; these are not mandatory branches
Tenant administrator
Verify App; allow repositories and enable PR verification
Choose publishing/execution principals; constrain limits
Team Verifier definitions
Publish independent exact versions through registry
Each application selects shared or local Verifiers
PR webhook or manual request
Authenticate, authorize and persist accepted work
No client review scheduler or Service Card required
Trusted configuration and durable execution
Resolve target-tree root wyrd.toml; declare local Cards or resolve exact registered Verifiers
Pin repository binding, configuration, PR identity, authority, limits and retained evidence references
Each selected Verifier gets its own execution/check
Extract pull_request using the public bohmian-code-review ReviewPipeline
Commit publications.evidence: pr.json, diff.patch, changes.json, changed/before and after, context.json
Reuse full library indexing/overlay/ranking/packing; extend its facade for complete pinned PR acquisition
Mount the same immutable directory at /inputs/pr for every reviewer; no injected Prompt inputs needed
1 Repeated sweeps
foreach: count 3
Same Agent, same PR mount, three private workspaces
Dispatch ready calls within existing server limits
Retain each invocation/attempt independently
2 Conditional specialists
General reviewer and planning Agent can run together
Planner returns security_review / concurrency_review
Each specialist has its own Agent Prompt and tools
Conditions select work; no assignment-array indirection
3 Speculative review
Two independent bootstrap Agents run as capacity allows
Each reads the same pinned evidence and publishes work
Any bootstrap success makes the extra pass eligible
Comparison waits for both settled collections
Collect three settled calls
Preserve ordered successful output array
Workspace collection also includes failed partial work
Manifest identifies status, attempt and actual paths
No failure becomes a clean empty review
Run selected security / concurrency Agents
Existing when: true runs; false intentionally skips
Decide before binding that branch workspace
Missing/wrong-type decision is an error, not false
Settled skipped collections remain mountable
Run extra pass while condition is pending
any_succeeded + ordinary when + speculative: true
Known false: no call; later false: cancel/exclude
True: admit; invalid/unavailable decision: block
Action completion alone never releases withheld content
Execution readers see discarded bytes; consumers cannot
Consolidate attached review work
Wait for producers and decisions to settle
Read manifests and admitted reports in workspace
Distinguish success, intentional skip and failure
Validate source claims; publish logical name report
Consolidate attached review work
Wait for producers and decisions to settle
Read manifests and admitted reports in workspace
Distinguish success, intentional skip and failure
Validate source claims; publish logical name report
Consolidate attached review work
Wait for producers and decisions to settle
Read manifests and admitted reports in workspace
Distinguish success, intentional skip and failure
Validate source claims; publish logical name report
Existing final Agent requirement and decide
Strictly mount successful consolidate.publications.report plus original PR evidence
Substantiated defect fails; insufficient evidence is inconclusive; complete supported clean review can pass
No platform finding schema, reviewer quorum or filename; named missing report remains missing evidence
Committed result and exact-head GitHub Check Run
Persist result/report manifests before terminal completion; delivery retries independently
Reconcile ambiguous remote writes and never regress terminal state or rerun committed review
Reports remain private and authorized; configuration/import failure never becomes an empty successful suite
Engine state / existing Bifrost shared writer
Memory drives execution; Bifrost WAL persists complete logical checkpoints
Keep exact File descriptors; preserve names, attempts, budgets and decisions
Takeover excludes stale writers; rejected WAL progress never resurrects
PostgreSQL owns queue claims and renewal, not duplicate execution state
Bifrost recovery / public APIs / UI
Load exact accepted state; unavailable means wait/retry, never fresh state
Keep selected result and execution_outputs; no terminal archive handoff
Inspect active/failed/discarded work under normal evidence permissions
Safe previews/downloads and stable pages through recovery/completion
Server-owned maintenance and boundaries
Default-branch pushes refresh library indexes; installation changes reconcile access and cancel revoked work
Library snapshot refresh and context cleanup use the public pipeline
No live finding-event successors, long-running streaming validator, automatic merge or extra orchestration service
